content.scenario: A consumer purchases a defective smartphone that explodes due to a manufacturing defect, causing injury. The consumer seeks compensation and replacement of the product.
content.outcome: The consumer is entitled to protection under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, and the manufacturer is liable to provide compensation and replacement of the defective product.
